items.ai_summary: AI trading agents for US stocks that incorporate macro calendars, news backtesting, and risk management tools to execute paper or live trades.

items.title: WorldDraft: If Code Builds the World, Can Video Models Just Render It?
items.description: Multimodal coding agents decouple 4D world construction from visual generation, repurposing video models from world generators toward generative renderers. This division of labor raises a fundamental question: if code builds the world, can video models just render it?

items.title: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
items.description: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation.

items.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
items.description: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require.

items.title: molly554/whiteboard-ai-tutor
items.description: Open-source AI tutor that teaches on a whiteboard. Benchmark of 6 LLMs (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek): 288 lessons drawn stroke by stroke, blind-reviewed. 白板 AI 导师 / AI 老师讲课评测
items.ai_summary: Open-source AI tutor and benchmark that teaches lessons by streaming drawing instructions as JSON to a whiteboard player in the browser.

items.title: fendouai/ViralForge
items.description: Agent-native viral video studio: one-click replicate viral short videos, deconstruct video hooks and scripts into a Viral DNA report, and ship 10 costed variants. Skill + MCP + CLI. Apache-2.0.
items.ai_summary: Agent-native viral video studio that deconstructs short videos into a structured report and generates editable project variants for A/B testing.

items.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
items.description: SO-Arena evaluates System One models across domains and capability families, revealing that scaling and reasoning gains vary and that high overall accuracy does not ensure reliable decision-making.

items.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.description: A reciprocal world model enables real-time full-duplex audiovisual interaction by jointly modeling intent and realization using autoregressive reasoning, synchronized attention, and dual rollout distillation.

items.title: Muanyan-mjq/zotero-interlinear
items.description: Immersive bilingual paragraph-by-paragraph reading for Zotero. Original on top, translation right below. Bring your own translation provider.
items.ai_summary: Zotero plugin that provides immersive bilingual paragraph-by-paragraph reading by rendering translations directly beneath foreign-language PDF text.

items.title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
items.description: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control.

items.title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
items.description: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity.

items.title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
items.description: Jointly selecting layers and modules in transformer foundation models yields better probing features than depth-only or final-layer approaches, and simple fixed strategies recover much of the gain.

items.title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
items.description: A systematic study of Hyper-Connections architectures identifies the simpler efficient design SimpleHC, which removes residual mixing and uses shared memory access to match mHC performance while adding minimal training overhead and improving stability.

items.title: Subliminal Learning in Vision-Language Models
items.description: Subliminal learning can transfer hidden preferences from teacher to student vision-language models through unrelated visual tasks, affecting image choices and explanations.

items.title: Qwen3.5 4B 3D Coder Studio
items.description: Interactive Three.js 3D scenes from a prompt

items.title: Evidence-Guided Recovery for AI Agents with Ambiguous Tool Outcomes and Partial Execution
items.description: Tool timeouts can leave AI agents facing ambiguous tool outcomes and partial execution: an action may have failed, committed or remained in flight while other workflow steps have already completed.

items.title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?
items.description: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so.

items.title: Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers
